properties_master_lease_has_head_rent.name: properties_master_lease_has_head_rent
properties_master_lease_has_head_rent.value: ownership_type <> 'master_lease' or head_rent_pence is not null

tenancies_end_details_match_status.name: tenancies_end_details_match_status
tenancies_end_details_match_status.value:
case when status in ('ending', 'ended')
        then end_date is not null and end_reason is not null
        else end_date is null and end_reason is null and notice_date is null end

tenancies_notice_within_tenancy.name: tenancies_notice_within_tenancy
tenancies_notice_within_tenancy.value: notice_date is null or (notice_date >= start_date and notice_date <= end_date)

tenancies_deposit_within_cap.name: tenancies_deposit_within_cap
tenancies_deposit_within_cap.value:
deposit_pence <= floor(
        (rent_pence::bigint * case rent_frequency when 'weekly' then 52 when 'fortnightly' then 26
          when 'four_weekly' then 13 else 12 end)::numeric
        * case when rent_pence::bigint * case rent_frequency when 'weekly' then 52
          when 'fortnightly' then 26 when 'four_weekly' then 13 else 12 end >= 5000000
          then 6 else 5 end / 52)

onboarding_steps_one_owner.name: onboarding_steps_one_owner
onboarding_steps_one_owner.value: not (owner_is_applicant and owner_user_id is not null)
